about_the_game:
An Amazing Night in Sanxingdui​​

First-Person Immersive Adventure-Puzzle Game

​​Journey into the Heart of Ancient Shu Civilization​​

Set against the enigmatic backdrop of the Sanxingdui Ruins in Guanghan, Sichuan, this game immerses players in the sacred rituals and technological marvels of the 3,000-year-old Shu Kingdom. As a modern high school graduate mysteriously transported to ancient Shu, you will decode bronze mechanisms, trace mythical patterns, recover lost artifacts, and commune with divine priests—transforming from a bystander into an active agent of history.

Core Features

​​"Bronze Artifacts Reborn" – Living Relics​​

Iconic treasures like the ​​Bronze Sacred Tree​​, ​​Gold Masks​​, and ​​Jade Scepters​​ dynamically respond to ritual music and player actions. Witness the 115 cm ​​Bronze Zun-Vessel Statue​​ (a kneeling figure crowned with dragon-adorned regalia) and the towering ​​Bronze Standing Figure​​ (2.6 m tall, embodying divine authority) awaken through your exploration.

​​Puzzles as Cultural Revelation​​

Reassembling bronze fragments unveils ​​mold-casting techniques​​ .

Tracing avian motifs on the Sacred Tree deciphers ​​"Offering Rites"​​  .

Knowledge becomes your natural reward, seamlessly blending archaeology with gameplay.

​​Time-Shifting Ritual Quest​​

Traverse meticulously reconstructed Shu landscapes—from moonlit riverbanks to palatial altars—to collect ritual objects. Collaborate with Shu inhabitants to advance ceremonies, mirroring the multi-pit sacrificial system of Sanxingdui .

Philosophical Depth: Animism & Civilizational Resonance

Inspired by “Shan Hai Jing” myths, the game explores ​​"Animism: Everything is Alive"​​ :

​​Artifacts transcend time​​: When you gaze upon the ​​Bronze Standing Figure​​, it gazes back—symbolizing the dialogue between past and present .

​​Archaeology as connection​​: "Uncovering relics is not just digging the past, but finding resonance between individual lives and the river of human civilization"
